newsitem.title: USA: U.S. weekly rice cash market summary -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. weekly rice cash market summary -- USDA.

text.p: In the South, rice prices were steady to weak for the week ended August 2, according to the USDA's rice cash market summary.
Long grain milled rice prices were mostly at $20.00 per cwt with discounts of up to $1.00; medium grain traded mostly at $18.00; second heads were steady and brewers were steady.
Rice by-products were uneven. Bran was $2.00 to $10.00 lower, millfeed was mostly steady.
In California, rice prices were steady with medium grain selling mostly at $18.00, second heads were steady, bran was $2.00 to $12.00 lower.
California rice ship loadings: For the week ending August 2, 1997, the Suthathip Naree loaded 14,146 tonnes of U.S. No. 1 medium grain milled rice destined for Turkey.

Inspections of California rice for export: For the week ending August 2, 1997, there were 312,004 cwt of rice inspected. The yearly total since October 1, 1996 is 10,359,531 cwt compared to 6,992,387 cwt a year ago.
